purpose: Closed runtime and audit contract repairing interface grounding, interventions, transitions, counters, accounting, replay preflight, and alarm finality for the frozen lesson.

interface_checks.invariant: The visible plate label is wrong for the cup image and cup is the unique replacement.

train_more.trigger: A controlled gate base score is below 6 of 8 after all eight base items and any mapped cold retests are complete.
train_more.selection_algorithm: Let F be the distinct labels whose base item in this gate is incorrect, in the gate's frozen base order. Release exactly one v5 reserve for each label in F, in that order; release no reserve for a correct label.
train_more.denominator: number of released reserves |F|, never eight and never the base denominator
train_more.score_update: Record reserve_score = correct released reserves / |F| separately; do not alter base_score or gate score.
train_more.success: |F| > 0 and reserve_score = |F|/|F|; then mark only those failed labels remediated and continue to the next phase.
train_more.zero_failure_case: If F is empty TRAIN_MORE is ineligible.
train_more.failure: Any released reserve incorrect, unavailable, or malformed yields defer_and_revisit; no second TRAIN_MORE release is permitted in this run.

train_longer.trigger: The frozen 32-item mixed base has completed with mixed_base_score < 26/32 and all required preconditions hold.
train_longer.identity_rule: Each extension event has a distinct event ID and reuses its frozen source contract/assets; it is never the source exercise ID and cannot be an immediate identical repeat.
train_longer.denominator: 8 extension events, separate from the frozen 32-item mixed denominator
train_longer.success: extension_score >= 7/8 marks mixed_remediated=true and transitions to picture_book; base score remains unchanged.
train_longer.failure: extension_score < 7/8 transitions to defer_and_revisit; no further TRAIN_LONGER or mixed repetition in this run.
train_longer.stop: Exactly eight extension events, then one terminal success/failure evaluation.

replay_lesson.trigger: A complete execution failure occurs and no alarm is active.
replay_lesson.preflight: Permit only if remaining_teacher_units >= 104, remaining_student_units >= 104, remaining_tool_calls >= 1, and replay_count = 0. Otherwise transition to defer_and_revisit.
replay_lesson.path: Replay the exact frozen base path once, including local presentations, checks, gates, mixed base, story, comprehension, transfer, and recap; do not replay interventions or extension events.
replay_lesson.accounting: A replay consumes exactly 104 teacher units and 104 student units; all replay events carry epoch=2 and original_event_id.
replay_lesson.stop: After one replay, evaluate the same finish predicate; a second replay is forbidden.

state_machine.finish_predicate: state=completed; all four gate base scores or successful failed-label TRAIN_MORE reserve scores recorded; mixed_base_score>=26/32 OR mixed extension_score>=7/8; ten story pages emitted; six narrative and eight transfer checks recorded; closing_recap>=6/8; no alarm or missing event.
state_machine.defer_predicate: Any declared bounded intervention fails, replay preflight fails, or closing recap is below threshold; write report and stop without further prompts.

event_schema.raw_response_rule: Preserve before normalization; null for non-response events.

audit_contract.per_item_rule: Counters are keyed by immutable exercise_id or extension_event_id; base and retest scores never overwrite one another.
audit_contract.chain_rule: event_sha256=SHA256(canonical_json(event_without_event_sha256)); chain_prev_sha256 is the prior event hash; terminal manifest binds final chain tip.
audit_contract.alternation_rule: Every Luna teacher/tool event is followed by exactly one Sol student/observation event, except terminal ALARM which is followed by no event; harness state events are not learner turns.

turn_accounting.unit_rule: One teacher unit per teacher_turn, machine_control, SHOW_CORRECT_OPTION, CHECK_UNDERSTANDING, presentation replay, scored selection, or any other teacher emission; one student unit per paired student turn. A tool call that emits a teacher-visible action counts as one teacher unit and one tool call.
turn_accounting.preflight: Before any replay or intervention, calculate remaining_teacher_units=240-used and remaining_student_units=240-used. Reject any action whose declared maximum units exceed remaining; ALARM on actual breach. REPLAY_LESSON additionally requires 108 remaining units, so it is reachable only before any extra emissions that reduce that reserve.
turn_accounting.intervention_reserves: TRAIN_MORE consumes one unit per released failed-label reserve; TRAIN_LONGER consumes exactly eight units; these are never silently included in base denominators.
turn_accounting.student_pair_rule: Every counted teacher unit requires one paired student observation/selection unit unless the terminal ALARM has no response.

automatic_triggers: global teacher, student, or tool budget breach
missing answer contract or invalid option
visible mismatch absent explicit wrong label and unique replacement
wrong page, caption, active-card state, or story order
alarm_contract.terminal_event: Append exactly one alarm event with trigger, raw evidence, state_before, state_after=alarm_frozen, and final chain hash; then append no further event and never transition out.
